text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While in town on the weekend, I spot
Symboli
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What about this store? No... I doubt it
would suit
his taste.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's out shopping, but
there are two
familiar figures shadowing
her...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: W-w-waaaait... I-I feel dizzy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Fine, get on my back and I'll carry
you! We can't
let Prez out of our sights!

text_block_list.name: Fancy Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Then may I suggest a fountain pen? We
have a
selection of designs from around
the world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... The Italian pen is splendid indeed.

However, I think I'll go with this German
one.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The marriage of elegant design with practical form hasn't changed since the company's founding. Something like this is exactly what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The recipient of this gift is someone I
hold dear to
my heart. Would it be
possible to add a message
card as well?

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text: D-dear to her heart?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it's not too much trouble, I'd like to
substitute
this dish in the course meal for
this antipasto.

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Employee
text_block_list.text:
Very well. We've also reserved a private
dining
room for you, as requested.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. I'm sure the two of us will
have a
relaxing evening, thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text: A private dining room... for two?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've just arrived at our rendezvous.
Hehe... I
can't wait to see you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She chose a present, reserved a private
dining
room in a fancy restaurant... And
by the sound of
that call, I bet she's on
a—

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text: Date!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, you two. What are you
saying?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
P-Prez?! Don't tell me you knew the
whole time...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's rather hard to miss you when
you're
being so obvious. You kept your
distance, but I
noticed you from a long
way off.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, what were we supposed to think?!

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a change of plans?!
Wait, you're
changing our plans?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I really do want to train with
you both.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I realize how sudden this is... However,
there's an
appointment I absolutely
cannot miss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies! I promise I'll make it up to
you. I'll
get in touch with you later, so...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
President Rudolf... Prioritizing something
over
training...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Must be someone really important to
her. Who
could it be?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: With a mystery like that, of course we were gonna find out what's going on! So spill the beans—who're you meeting with?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Well, he's an integral part of my
life—so
much so, that it would be
difficult to find an
aspect of myself he
hasn't influenced.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...H-he's that important? Could he be... I mean, I don't want to assume, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I speak of none other than my
grandfather.

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsurumaru
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
He lives in France, but he's returning to
Japan for
a spell. I was running all those
errands in
preparation for our reunion.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wow, your grandfather... If he's anything
like you,
I bet he's a wonderful person!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, he is! Perhaps it's due to his
extensive travels,
but his every word and
deed is filled with
elegance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was a little girl, I've looked
up to him
as a figure I'd like to emulate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's why you saw me running about
town today.
I want to welcome him in a
manner befitting the
regard I hold for
him.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: You really admire him, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I think I get what you mean! So...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... We're gonna head back. It's not
every day
you get to see your
grandfather, so we'll get out
of your
hair! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh! But if you want to mention that you have two clever juniors who look up to you, we won't stop you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks, you two. I'll make the
most of this
day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure why I keep running into
these three
today, but I'm glad I got to
glimpse this
heartwarming scene.
